statement: I can recognize greetings and words for people when spoken slowly.
source: checked against CEFR self-assessment grid (Europass copy, Council of Europe 2004-2020), A1, A1, Listening
cefr_descriptor: I can understand familiar words and very basic phrases concerning myself, my family and immediate concrete surroundings when people speak slowly and clearly.

statement: I can understand short sentences that say who someone is.
source: checked against CEFR self-assessment grid (Europass copy, Council of Europe 2004-2020), A1, A1, Reading
cefr_descriptor: I can understand familiar names, words and very simple sentences, for example on notices and posters or in catalogues.

statement: I can write a greeting and say who I am.
source: checked against CEFR self-assessment grid (Europass copy, Council of Europe 2004-2020), A1, A1, Writing
cefr_descriptor: I can write a short, simple postcard, for example sending holiday greetings. I can fill in forms with personal details, for example entering my name, nationality and address on a hotel registration form.

statement: I can greet someone and say who I am.
source: checked against CEFR self-assessment grid (Europass copy, Council of Europe 2004-2020), A1, A1, Spoken interaction
cefr_descriptor: I can interact in a simple way provided the other person is prepared to repeat or rephrase things at a slower rate of speech and help me formulate what I'm trying to say. I can ask and answer simple questions in areas of immediate need or on very familiar topics.
